svg.title: AssetStream: the power reserve
svg.desc: Plate six, AssetStream, curves illustrative: a power-reserve gauge of retained value from new to retire. An age-only hand falls to 22 while the telemetry-informed hand stops at 38, and a billing-cycle sub-dial ticks below. Django, Celery and Redis turn IoT usage into invoices; a scikit-learn model prices resale; Next.js and TypeScript front end with a Groq LLM; fully Dockerized. Live, source public.
